signal: Anti-lottery: z(-Skewness_63d) + z(-GKVol) + z(PosFrac)
paper: Boyer, Mitton & Vorkink (2010) RFS; Barberis & Huang (2008) JFE

name: Return Dispersion Regime
signal: Dispersion-ratio regime: high-dispersion → quality-momentum, low-dispersion → defensive
paper: Stivers & Sun (2010) RFS; Garcia-Feijoo (2012) JF

name: Intraday Efficiency Ratio
signal: Efficiency ratio (net/total move) + intraday range position + GKVol
paper: Kaufman (1995); Lo, Mamaysky & Wang (2000) JF

name: Momentum Crash Protection
signal: 12M momentum with crash detection: bear+highvol → switch to quality
paper: Daniel & Moskowitz (2016) JFE; Cooper, Gutierrez & Hameed (2004) JF

name: Long-Run Reversal
signal: 5-year loser reversal: z(-LRR_5Y) + z(-GKVol), skip last 1Y
paper: DeBondt & Thaler (1985) JF; Fama & French (1996) JF

name: Liquidity Provision Premium
signal: Middle-turnover stocks (closest to median): z(-LiqMid) + quality + GKVol
paper: Amihud (2002) JFM; Chordia, Roll & Subrahmanyam (2001) JFE

name: Multi-Horizon Momentum Blend
paper: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993) JF; Novy-Marx (2012) JFE

name: Net Buying Pressure
signal: Close>Open fraction (21d/63d) + z(-GKVol); institutional accumulation proxy
paper: Hvidkjaer (2008); Kaniel, Saar & Titman (2008); Barber & Odean (2008)

name: Volatility Term Structure
signal: GKVol_10d/GKVol_63d ratio; buy vol compression candidates
paper: Engle (1982); Bollerslev (1986); Drechsler & Yaron (2011)

name: Absolute Momentum
signal: Antonacci dual momentum; exclude stocks with negative 12M return
paper: Antonacci (2012); Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012); Asness, Moskowitz & Pedersen (2013)

name: Market Breadth Timing
signal: Fraction of stocks above 63d MA as regime overlay (bullish/neutral/defensive)
paper: Whaley (2000); Zweig (1986); Faber (2007)

name: Momentum Acceleration
signal: Rate of change in 6M momentum; (Mom6M_cur - Mom6M_lag) / (|Mom6M_lag|+0.01)
paper: Grinblatt & Moskowitz (2004); Rouwenhorst (1998); Sagi & Seasholes (2007)

name: overnight_persistence
description: Overnight Return Persistence — fraction of positive overnight gaps (Open/PrevClose-1) in 21d/63d windows; institutional accumulation proxy

name: pvt_momentum
description: PVT Momentum — cumulative Price-Volume Trend (Ret*Volume) normalized; volume-confirmed price momentum

name: rsi_quality
description: RSI Quality — fraction of days RSI>50 over 63 days; consistent momentum zone indicator

name: range_position
description: 52-Week Range Position — (Close-Low_252d)/(High_252d-Low_252d); position within annual price range

name: ew_momentum
description: Exponentially Weighted Momentum — monthly returns discounted by lambda=0.85 per month back; recency-weighted 12M momentum

name: sortino_proxy
description: Sortino Proxy — downside-risk-adjusted return proxy: mean(Ret)*252 / sqrt(mean(min(Ret,0)^2)*252)

name: gain_loss_ratio
description: Gain-Loss Ratio — mean(gains) / mean(|losses|) over 63d; return asymmetry and PosFrac quality

name: intraday_hl_position
description: Intraday HL Position — (Close-Low)/(High-Low) fraction over 21d/63d; closing near day's high = sustained buying

name: beta_regime
description: Beta Regime Fitness — beta proximity to target (1.0 normal, low-beta elevated); + beta stability across windows

name: ma200_distance
description: MA200 Distance — (Close-MA200)/MA200 clipped at 95th pctile + MA200 slope; trend strength filter

name: vw_momentum
description: Volume-Weighted Momentum — Ret_t * (Vol_t/AvgVol) over 63d skip 21; high-volume days count more

name: streak_quality
description: Streak Quality — max consecutive positive-return days (21d) + avg streak length (63d)

name: conditional_momentum
description: Market-State Conditional Momentum — full momentum in up-market (BM_3M>0), defensive in down-market

name: vol_return_confirm
description: Volume-Return Confirmation — fraction of high-vol-up days + fraction of low-vol-down days; institutional trading proxy

name: consistent_momentum
description: Consistent Multi-Horizon Momentum — fraction of 4 horizons (1M/3M/6M/12M) where stock ranks top 50%

name: return_autocorr
description: Return Autocorrelation — lag-1 and mean lag-1..5 autocorrelation of 63d daily returns; positive AC = trending

name: range_compression
description: Range Compression — (H-L)/Close ratio short/long window; low ratio = Bollinger squeeze, coiling for breakout

name: variance_ratio
description: Variance Ratio Momentum — VR(4) and VR(8) variance ratios; VR>1 indicates trending (positive autocorrelation)

name: turnover_accel
description: Turnover Acceleration — AvgVol_21d/AvgVol_63d ratio × PosFrac; volume surge + positive returns = institutional accumulation

name: hivol_trend
description: High-Volume Trend Signal — cumulative signed return on top-10% volume days over 63d/21d; net institutional direction

name: cavol
description: CAVOL — cumulative abnormal volume: sum(Vol_t/AvgVol_63-1) over 21d × sign(Mom21d); attention-driven accumulation

name: lowskew_momentum
description: Low-Skewness Momentum — 12M momentum penalized by positive 63d skewness; anti-lottery momentum filter

name: topdecile_consistency
description: Top-Decile Consistency — fraction of 12 rolling monthly windows where stock in top 20% cross-sectionally

name: sharpe_autocorr
description: Sharpe-AutoCorr Composite — Sharpe_63d × (1 + AutoCorr1_63d); corrected Sharpe for trending stocks

name: vol_trend_momentum
description: Volume Trend Momentum — OLS slope of volume over 63d (normalized) × Mom6M direction; rising volume + momentum

name: Anti-MAX Factor
description: Avoids lottery stocks with high maximum single-day returns over 21d/63d windows. High-MAX stocks are overpriced by retail gambling demand.
source_papers: Bali et al. 2011 JFE maxing out

name: Return Stability (Low CoV)
description: Selects stocks with stable positive returns: low coefficient of variation (std/mean) over 63 days. Stable returns indicate low uncertainty and predictable fundamentals.
source_papers: Ang et al. 2006 JF downside risk

name: Interaction Alpha (Mom x Low-Vol)
description: Multiplicative interaction of momentum and low-vol z-scores: max(0,z_mom)*max(0,z_gkn). Requires both signals positive simultaneously — quality filter eliminating lottery-momentum and defensive losers.

name: IVOL-Adjusted Momentum
description: 6M momentum computed on residuals after removing market beta (CAPM residuals). Purifies momentum from market beta noise; IVOL of residuals also penalized.
source_papers: Blitz et al. 2011 JEF residual momentum

name: Close-Open Gap Momentum
description: Cumulative intraday buying pressure: sum of (Close-Open)/Open over 21 and 63 trading days. Captures institutional accumulation during market hours (vs overnight gap).
source_papers: Lou et al. 2019 JFE day night returns
Cliff et al. 2008 RFS overnight intraday

name: Earnings Surprise Momentum (SUE Proxy)
description: PEAD proxy without DART: uses 3-day cumulative returns around month-end dates as SUE proxy. Cumulates these over 3M/6M windows to capture earnings drift.
source_papers: Chan Jegadeesh Lakonishok 1996 JF momentum earnings

name: Price Momentum + ST Reversal Combo
description: 12M-1M momentum combined with short-term reversal avoidance. z(Mom12_1) + z(-STR_1M): rewards sustained momentum while penalizing recent 1M winners who face reversal risk.

name: Beta-Adjusted Momentum
description: 6M momentum divided by market beta: BetaAdjMom = Mom6M / max(beta_63, 0.5). Removes market-beta component from momentum signal; in elevated VIX adds explicit low-beta tilt.

name: Intraday-to-Total Vol Ratio
description: Ratio of intraday absolute log return to total (intraday+overnight) absolute movement over 21d/63d. High ratio = institutional (market-hours) driven volatility; low ratio = retail overnight noise.
source_papers: Cliff Cooper Gulen 2008 RFS overnight intraday

name: Amihud-Adjusted Momentum
description: 6M momentum scaled by Amihud illiquidity: AdjMom = Mom6M / (Amihud21 + 0.1). Rewards liquid momentum over illiquid momentum; implementation-aware signal.

name: Momentum Dispersion
description: Cross-sectional momentum dispersion: Mom6M minus cross-sectional median and Mom12M minus median. Captures pure relative outperformance vs the universe, not market beta.

name: Volatility of Volatility (VoV)
description: Second-order volatility: CoV of GK_daily series over 21/63 days. Low VoV = stable volatility regime → predictable risk → easier to hold and risk-manage.
source_papers: Gatheral et al. 2018 QF rough vol
Bollerslev Todorov 2011 JF fears risk premia

name: Price Efficiency (Variance Ratio)
description: Lo-MacKinlay variance ratio: VR(4) and VR(8) over 63-day window. TrendScore = (VR4-1)+(VR8-1); EffScore = 1-|VR4-1|-|VR8-1|. Rewards trending-efficient stocks.

name: Open-to-Open Momentum
description: 6M and 3M momentum computed from open-to-open daily returns instead of close-to-close. Open prices reflect pre-market informed trading; different information set from standard momentum.
source_papers: Berkman et al. 2012 JFE trading before open

name: Drawdown Recovery Strength
description: Measures how quickly stocks recover from 63-day drawdowns: RecovStrength = recov_frac * (1 + pos_frac). Quick recovery signals institutional support and buying pressure on dips.
source_papers: Grossman Zhou 1993 JF optimal drawdown control

name: Momentum-Quality Blend
description: Additive blend of 6M momentum and quality score (Sortino + PosFrac). Unlike multiplicative interaction (STR_177), additive allows either signal to contribute. Momentum provides alpha; quality provides crash protection.

name: Sector-Relative Momentum
description: Stock's 6M/12M momentum minus its sector peer median. Captures intra-sector leadership rather than sector-level rotation. Avoids sector timing risk while isolating stock-specific momentum alpha.

name: Market-Cap Adjusted Momentum
description: 6M/3M momentum scaled by cross-sectional size rank. Mild penalty for large-cap (easier to execute) vs bonus for smaller stocks. Accounts for size-momentum interaction in Korean market.
source_papers: Hong Lim Stein 2000 JF bad news

name: Low-Volatility Quality
description: Multi-dimensional low-vol with quality bias: LVQScore = (1/GKVol + 1/DsVol) * QualBias where QualBias = PosFrac * (1 - |skew| * 0.05). Avoids flat low-vol stocks with no directional trend.
source_papers: Ang Hodrick Xing Zhang 2006 JF volatility

name: Volume-Price Trend (VPT) Oscillator
description: Cumulative volume-weighted price changes (OBV variant): VPT_delta = VPT_21d - VPT_63d and VPT_ratio = short/long. Rising delta = accelerating institutional buying pressure with volume confirmation.
source_papers: Llorente et al. 2002 RFS volume-return relation

name: Residual Return Momentum (FF3)
description: 6M momentum on FF3 residuals: removes market beta + size factor. Uses BM return as MKT proxy and cross-sectional daily small-minus-large as SMB proxy. Cleaner signal than CAPM residual.
source_papers: Blitz Huij Martens 2011 JEF residual momentum

name: Trend Strength Index (ADX)
description: Directional ADX = ADX_14 * sign(DI+ - DI-). ADX measures trend strength (0-100); direction sign converts to signed strength. Combined with 6M momentum for confirmation.

name: Cross-Asset Momentum Spillover
description: Individual stock 6M momentum amplified/dampened by market momentum state. BM_Mom6M > 0 → amplify by up to 1.5x; negative → dampen. Captures momentum spillover from index level to individual stocks.
source_papers: Asness et al. 2013 JF value momentum everywhere
Moskowitz Ooi Pedersen 2012 JFE time series momentum

name: Reversal-Filtered Momentum
description: 6M momentum penalized 75% for stocks in reversal danger zone: both 1W and 1M return in top quartile. Avoids crowded short-term bounce plays that contaminate momentum signal.

name: Z-Score Composite (Kitchen Sink)
description: Equal-weighted z-score composite of 5 signals: Mom6M, -GKVol, PosFrac, Sortino proxy, COGap21. Tests if broad diversification of signals outperforms focused strategies.

name: Regime-Adaptive Composite
description: MILESTONE: Dynamic 5-factor composite with regime-conditional weights. Normal: 25% Mom + 20% LowVol + 15% COGap + 20% Sortino + 20% BetaAdjMom. Elevated: 5% Mom + 40% LowVol + 10% COGap + 30% Sortino + 15% BetaAdjMom.
source_papers: Asness Moskowitz Pedersen 2013 JF value momentum

name: Momentum Seasonality
description: 6M momentum adjusted by Korean market seasonal multipliers by month. January +15%, August -10%, December -5%. Amplifies positive momentum in seasonally strong months, dampens in weak months.

name: Low-Leverage Proxy (Price-Based)
description: Price-based leverage proxy without DART: vol/market_vol ratio + downside tail ratio. Low-leverage stocks have lower vol/market ratio and smaller downside tail relative to total vol.

name: Realized Sharpe Ratio
description: Multi-horizon realized Sharpe: 40%*RS_63 + 35%*RS_126 + 25%*RS_252. Captures risk-adjusted return persistence across 3M, 6M, and 1Y horizons. Different from raw momentum: rewards efficient risk utilization.

name: Price Inertia Score
description: Three-component inertia: (1) month-positive fraction over 12M, (2) current close / 52W MA, (3) 3M/12M acceleration ratio. Broad multi-horizon measure of price continuation tendency.

name: Momentum Breadth
description: 6M momentum conditioned on market breadth (fraction of stocks with positive 1M return). ConditionalMom = Mom6M * (0.5 + breadth_score). BreadthResidual = stock's 1M rank - breadth_score.

name: Kurtosis Filter (Low Fat Tails)
description: Avoids stocks with high excess kurtosis (fat tails) in 63-day return distribution. Fisher excess kurtosis; low kurtosis = predictable risk profile, thin tails, institutional preference.

name: Persistence Factor
description: Cross-sectional rank stability over 12 months: TopDecileN * 2 + ConsistentTop50. Rewards stocks that consistently outrank peers month after month, not just cumulatively.
source_papers: Hendricks Patel Zeckhauser 1993 JF hot hands

name: Dual Momentum
description: Antonacci dual momentum for cross-section: RelMom6M (cross-sectional rank) AND AbsMom (Mom6M > 0). DualMom = RelMom if AbsMom, penalized otherwise. Both relative AND absolute filter required.

name: Volume Acceleration
description: Signed volume acceleration: AvgVol_10d/AvgVol_30d * sign(ret_10d) + AvgVol_21d/AvgVol_63d * sign(ret_21d). Volume surge in the direction of recent price movement = institutional entry confirmation.
source_papers: Blume Easley OHara 1994 JF market statistics

name: Price Gap Momentum
description: Cumulative overnight gaps (Open/PrevClose-1) as informed buying signal

name: Momentum Convexity
description: Quadratic curvature of cumulative return path — accelerating momentum

name: Rolling Alpha
description: Rolling OLS alpha vs benchmark — sustained active return quality

name: Tail Ratio
description: Upside/downside tail ratio from return distribution — positive asymmetry

name: Information Ratio Proxy
description: Realized information ratio vs benchmark — consistent active return

name: Mean Reversion Band
description: Bollinger Band z-score mean reversion — moderate negative z-score favored

name: Momentum Half-Life
description: AR(1) autocorrelation half-life — stocks with persistent momentum decay

name: Volume-Weighted Momentum
description: Volume-scaled daily returns cumulated — high volume days count more

name: Return Skewness Filter
description: Sample skewness of return distribution — positive skew stocks favored

name: Price Range Momentum
description: Average daily close-in-range position — consistent upper-range closings

name: Beta Momentum
description: Asymmetric up-market vs down-market beta — convex payoff vs benchmark

name: Price Oscillator
description: EMA price oscillator (MACD-style) — trend quality and acceleration

name: Return Seasonality
description: Stock-specific day-of-week and calendar-month return seasonality

name: Volatility-Adjusted Momentum
description: 6M/3M momentum divided by realized volatility — Sharpe-adjusted trend

name: Composite Quality Factor
description: 5-component price-based quality composite: PosFrac+Sortino+TailRatio+MaxDD+Vol

name: Momentum Quality Gate
description: Momentum gated by quality pass/fail — zero score for low-quality stocks

name: Residual Volatility
description: Idiosyncratic volatility from OLS residuals vs benchmark — low IVOL favored

name: Earnings Drift Proxy
description: Post-earnings announcement drift proxy from quarter-end 3-day returns

name: Price Momentum Reversal Blend
description: Regime-adaptive blend of 6M momentum and short-term reversal avoidance

name: Long-Short Breadth Signal
description: Market breadth A/D ratio multiplier on 6M momentum signal

name: High-Low Ratio
description: 52-week and 6-month high ratio — proximity to historical high as momentum

name: Volume Trend Strength
description: OLS slope of normalized volume confirming price trend direction

name: CoMomentum
description: Momentum adjusted for crowding correlation with top-decile stocks

name: Lottery Factor Reverse
description: Reverse lottery factor — avoid high MAX5 stocks, favor boring ones

name: Reversal Consistency
description: Fraction of weekly returns showing mean-reversion — favor low reverters

name: Momentum Regime Filter
description: Regime-adaptive momentum: 12M-1M in low VIX, 3M in elevated VIX with vol ceiling filter

name: Price Efficiency Hurst
description: Hurst exponent from R/S analysis — trending stocks (H>0.5) combined with momentum

name: Multi-Factor Equal Weight
description: FINAL MILESTONE: 7-factor equal-weight grand composite — Mom+Vol+PosFrac+HL52W+AntiLottery+Range+Sortino

name: Rank Average Ensemble
idea: Percentile rank average of 5 orthogonal factors

name: Regime-Conditional Mix
idea: Complete factor swap per VIX regime

name: Quality-Momentum Gate
idea: Quality filter then momentum, gated approach

name: Intersection Portfolio
idea: All 4 factors top-50% intersection, high conviction
